# submission name:
janos_svc_resdgain

# upload zipped `archive.zip`
https://github.com/Janos95/comma_video_compression_challenge/releases/download/janos_svc_resdgain_archive_v1/archive.zip

# report.txt
```
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.0005125586
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.0007008022
  Submission file size: 237,420 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,652 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.0063235019
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 0.2997609608
```

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
yes

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
no

# additional comments
Semantic-vector mask codec plus compact generator, selected lane row-control, RESD subset, and per-pair residual gain sidecar packed into `lane.rc.br`.

Smoke test: `evaluate.sh --device cuda` inflated successfully on an A10 GPU box. That environment lacked `nvidia.dali`, so the official CUDA evaluator path stopped at evaluator startup; the same inflated output was then scored with the no-DALI evaluator at `0.2997609608`.

comments.body:
Thanks for the submission @Janos95! 🤏

A maintainer will review your PR shortly.

To run the evaluation, a maintainer will trigger the `eval` workflow with your PR number.
Closing per author request after validating that the official CUDA/DALI evaluator reports a worse score than the no-DALI smoke test.
